mapper.select: SELECT rr.id, COALESCE(ui.nickname, ui.phone) AS user_name, ui.phone AS user_phone, ai.name AS apartment_name, ri.room_number, rr.title, rr.description, rr.priority, rr.status, rr.appointment_time, rr.contact_phone, su.name AS handler_name, rr.finish_time, rr.remark, rr.create_time FROM repair_request rr LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON rr.user_id = ui.id AND ui.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON rr.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON ri.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_user su ON rr.handler_id = su.id AND su.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rr.is_deleted = 0 AND rr.id = #{id}
